```{r qc-setup, include=FALSE}
# rna_01_qc_report.Rmd
# HTML report generated by rna_01.1_qc.R via rmarkdown::render();
# uses the variables of that script (RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE, OUT_PREFIX...) and reads
# tables and figures from results/<RECEPTOR>/<CELL_LINE>/. Not run on its own.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,
                      fig.align="center", dpi=150)
library(dplyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

fmt_tbl <- function(df, caption=NULL)
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
  kable(caption=caption) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)

res_dir <- here::here("results", RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE)
fig_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")
```

> **Dataset:** `r OUT_PREFIX` · **Normalization:** edgeR TMM + log2CPM · **Min count filter:** `r MIN_COUNT`

## Processing

```{r qc-stats}
qc <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "01_qc_stats.csv"), check.names=FALSE)
fmt_tbl(
  data.frame(
    Parameter = c("Input genes", "Genes after filter", "Retention", "Samples",
                  "PC1 variance", "PC2 variance"),
    Value = c(qc$Genes_input[1], qc$Genes_filtered[1],
              paste0(qc$Retention_pct[1], "%"), nrow(qc),
              paste0(qc$PC1_var[1], "%"), paste0(qc$PC2_var[1], "%"))
  ), "QC summary"
)
```

## Library quality

```{r lib-quality}
qc |> dplyr::select(Sample, Condition, Reads, Median_log2CPM, TMM_factor) |>
  fmt_tbl("Library quality per sample")
```

TMM factors range: `r round(min(qc$TMM_factor),3)` – `r round(max(qc$TMM_factor),3)`.

knitr::include_graphics(pca_file)
